portfolioProjects.name: CiudadanoUSA
portfolioProjects.description: A Spanish-first mobile app for U.S. citizenship interview preparation, designed for people who study in Spanish and need confidence answering in English.
portfolioProjects.problem: Citizenship preparation is fragmented: official materials, location-dependent answers, and limited help bridging Spanish study with English interview answers.
portfolioProjects.user: Spanish-speaking immigrants preparing civics, the N-400 interview, English reading, and writing in a high-anxiety context.
portfolioProjects.solution: A bilingual app with civics study, mock interview, N-400 rehearsal, reading/writing practice, audio, and elected-official lookup by ZIP code.
portfolioProjects.role: Product, design, React Native/Expo, Supabase backend, RevenueCat monetization, launch, and bilingual marketing site.
portfolioProjects.outcome: Published on iOS and Android with a Pro flow, USCIS-aligned content, and an experience designed for a real bilingual user.
highlights: Civics 2025 (128 questions) and 2008 (100 questions) study banks aligned with USCIS
Mock interview, N-400 rehearsal, English reading and writing practice
Elected officials lookup by ZIP code for location-dependent civics answers
CarPlay and Android Auto audio for studying on the go (Pro)
Pro subscriptions via RevenueCat with a Supabase backend — React Native and Expo

screenshots.alt: CiudadanoUSA home screen with study progress, streak, and interview countdown
N-400 practice screen with progress by naturalization form section
English writing practice with word-by-word feedback and Spanish translation
